# ReToken

> ReToken is a free, open-source (MIT) local proxy written in Rust that reduces the token cost of AI coding agents such as Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Windsurf, RooCode, Aider and Codex. It runs on 127.0.0.1:8888 between the agent and the model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or any compatible endpoint), compresses tool output, places prompt-cache breakpoints, and can ask for terse replies. It never shortens a file the model is still reading, and every lossy change can be undone through its `retoken_retrieve` MCP tool.

Repository: https://github.com/AshleyImmanuel/ReToken
License: MIT
Language: Rust
Maintainer: Immanuel Ashley (https://github.com/AshleyImmanuel)

## What problem does ReToken solve?

Coding agents re-send the whole conversation every turn, including long build logs, test output, JSON and file reads. Most of an agent's API bill is this input. ReToken removes the noise from that input on the wire, so the same agent completes the same task for less money, with no change to the agent itself.

## Measured results

- Headless Claude Code benchmark (Claude Sonnet, November 2026, 3 tasks x 3 repeats per setup, all 36 runs correct): direct API $0.0425 per task, caveman proxy $0.0330, ReToken $0.0329, ReToken + terse mode $0.0302 (29% below direct, 3.78 turns against 4.78).

## How it works

1. Exact duplicate tool output is replaced by a reference to the earlier copy (lossless, always on).
2. Large build, test and log output is shortened; errors, assertion details and test summaries are always kept.
3. A file read reaches the model in full on the turn it is read; once stale, large files become an outline with exact line numbers.
4. Pretty-printed JSON from commands is minified without changing its value.
5. Anthropic prompt-cache breakpoints are placed to match the client's TTL, so repeated history is billed at the cached rate.
6. Optional terse mode asks the model for short prose replies; code and tool inputs stay normal.

## Common questions

- How do I reduce Claude Code token usage? Run Claude Code through ReToken: `cargo install --path cli`, `claude mcp add retoken -- retoken mcp`, then `retoken wrap claude`.
- Does ReToken work with a Claude Pro or Max subscription? Yes. It forwards the client's own authorization headers, including Claude Code OAuth.
- Does ReToken send my code to a third party? No. It listens on loopback only and forwards requests only to the provider the agent already uses.
- Is it safe for agent quality? Lossy changes happen only when the agent has the retrieval tool, and fresh file reads are never shortened.
- How is it different from prompt plugins that make the model terse? Those shorten replies only. ReToken also cuts input (tool output, duplicates, cache placement) and includes a terse mode.
